question.wording: Is the account this statement reports an IRA, a 401(k) or another qualified retirement plan?

options.label: Yes — a retirement account; its sales are not reported

default.because: A brokerage form reports a taxable account unless a preparer says it is an IRA or qualified plan

citation.wording: The rules in this publication do not apply to investments held in individual retirement arrangements (IRAs), section 401(k) plans, and other qualified retirement plans.
